bull_bear.body: Reinvest in AI/security practice; hire enterprise sales leaders; build U.S. billing entity (light model: fractional consultants); no dividends or buybacks mentioned
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: India’s cost-sensitive pricing environment; geopolitical delays in global expansion; dependency on AWS pricing stability; credit risk from new clients (exited Dubai gaming deal due to credit concerns)
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, strategic, and disciplined; emphasized AI as next engine, recurring revenue depth, and prudent capital allocation; rejected high-revenue Dubai deal due to credit risk; global expansion cautious but intentional
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: IntelliOps AI platform is already deployed with 60%+ clients, reducing need for headcount growth despite revenue surge; AWS partnership grants preferential access to leads and funding incentives, creating a moat; AI revenue is embedded in cloud contracts, making pure-play AI revenue misleadingly low
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Cloud foundation & migration: core; Managed services: 82.5% of revenue; AI acceleration: INR 2cr revenue in FY26 (influenced INR 10cr+ cloud revenue); Security: growing practice; FinOps: embedded in managed services
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

latest_quarter.body: EBITDA margin down due to INR 6cr headcount investment (170 FTEs) and INR 7.5cr revenue loss; normalized PAT margin 14-15%; FY27 margin recovery via: (1) higher-margin AI/security mix, (2) utilization from 84% to 88%, (3) AI-driven productivity (IntelliOps reducing L1 load); employee cost: INR 9-10L/head, expected to rise to INR 11-12L/head with AI reskilling
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: 45% to INR 210cr; margin: PAT margin target ~11.5-12% (INR 24-25cr PAT); order inflow: INR 20cr incremental new business needed in 10 months; capex/commissioning: minimal (cloud infrastructure via AWS); no capex beyond headcount
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: INR 190cr visible: INR 160cr contracted recurring revenue (INR 13.5cr MRR), INR 30cr pipeline (Agentic AI, manufacturing analytics, insurer transformation, fintech cloud migration)
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Global expansion (U.S. billing entity in progress, Singapore scaling); AI productization (IntelliOps platform for marketplace); enterprise account expansion (7-8 deals in pipeline for Q2); SMB-to-enterprise shift
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality
